test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, J, K, L and M are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Four of them are sitting at either of the corners while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of either of the sides.

D sits at one of the corners of the table. Only two people sit between D and C, when counted from the left of D. Only three people sit between C and B. M sits third to the left of B. K sits to the immediate right of M. A is neither an immediate neighbour of B nor C. J sits to the immediate left of A.

Who sits second to the right of L?
solution:
According to given information,

1. Number of persons = 8

2. Name of persons → A, B, C, D, J, K, L and M

3. D sits at one of the corners of the table. Only two people sit between D and C, when counted from the left of D. Only three people sit between C and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee82d43f46314799d729003e2f103f5ec5773f4bce64afa0bfad4e9e9c99f20f.png] 

4. M sits third to the left of B. K sits to the immediate right of M. A is neither an immediate neighbour of B nor C. J sits to the immediate left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97439309d69ff446ff019a0762f32d62abfc31cc410b9ed1125283c12a3a46e6.png] 

Thus, M sits second to the right of L.

Hence, **'option 4' **is the correct answer.
